paragraphs.dominant_move: context-and-physical-input: Open-water aircraft loss requires estimating searchable targets before location inference. -> creates a target-state input -> moves to search and allocation

search-allocation-and-cases: Sequential surface and underwater evidence can update location priorities and resource assignments. -> creates an end-to-end workflow promise -> moves to sensitivity and limitations
scope-and-limit: The system is claimed adaptable but retains computation, assumption, and parameter barriers. -> states the intended evaluation boundary -> the introduction must justify the task
incident-history: Delayed recovery makes maritime search planning consequential. -> establishes the operational stakes -> identifies the observation gap
evidence-gap: Sparse data and poorly known ocean geography limit localization. -> defines the information bottleneck -> states concrete model outputs

task-contract: A useful generic plan must connect physical target generation, motion, probabilistic search, allocation, cases, and evaluation. -> commits the paper to inspectable deliverables -> base analysis types the inputs

global_organization_chain: Only after the positive language, organization, model, and visual chain is complete does G7 record formula, parameter, likelihood, optimizer, validation, sensitivity, reference, and scope warnings.

moves: input: A lost aircraft in open water, sparse incident evidence, heterogeneous search aircraft, and a two-stage maritime search problem.
rhetorical job: Preview the positive physical-to-probabilistic-to-allocation workflow before naming sensitivity and limitations.
analytical job: Name drifter-count estimation, current-driven simulation, surface and underwater Bayesian updates, branch-and-bound allocation, AF447/MH370 applications, and sensitivity.
output: A conditional promise that the system can prioritize search regions and resources for a declared incident scenario.
handoff: The contents and introduction unpack the model stages, case evidence, evaluation, public explanation, and source record.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The summary's collision, search, allocation, application, and evaluation promise.
rhetorical job: Expose all source sections and keep surface search, underwater recursion, allocation, cases, sensitivity, public communication, and references distinct.

analytical job: Order base analysis; five assumption groups; notation; collision, simulation, Bayesian, surface, underwater, and allocation models; two applications; six sensitivity subsections; evaluation; press paper; references.
output: A complete source-heading map for the 34-page argument.
handoff: The introduction supplies the delayed-recovery context and seven explicit tasks.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The unresolved MH370 search, AF447's nearly two-year underwater recovery, sparse data, and poorly charted ocean geography.
rhetorical job: Turn public incidents into a bounded modeling and decision agenda rather than a general call for rescue technology.
analytical job: Require drifter count, drift simulation, sequential Bayesian search, aircraft allocation, AF447 retrospective use, MH370 prediction, and strengths/weaknesses analysis.
output: Seven observable deliverables for an open-water missing-aircraft search system.
handoff: Base analysis identifies which target and platform attributes enter those deliverables.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: Candidate crashed-aircraft types and helicopter/fixed-wing search platforms with different physical and sensing properties.
rhetorical job: Separate target-generation factors from search-capability factors before they are combined in one plan.
analytical job: Connect aircraft size, passenger capacity, and material to drifter count; connect search speed, range, and sensors to cell coverage and detection.
output: Two typed parameter families for the collision and allocation layers.
handoff: The assumptions state which real differences are retained, collapsed, or omitted.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The target and platform heterogeneity identified in the base analysis.
rhetorical job: Expose the operating regime of every downstream physical, simulation, probabilistic, and allocation result.

analytical job: Fix full load, two disintegration regimes, equal fragments, simplified impulse, common initial target state, current-plus-random surface motion, static seabed parts, stationary targets during search, no false positives, aircraft-only assets, weather-invariant capability, and area limits replacing range.
output: A component-indexed assumption contract.
handoff: The notation table defines the quantities consumed under this contract.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: Collision, drift, search-state, and platform-detection concepts from Sections 3-4.
rhetorical job: Keep maximum and actual target counts, crash mechanics, spatial probabilities, and surface/underwater likelihoods distinguishable.
analytical job: Define N0, N, V, m, alpha, beta, v, theta, I, S_i,j, D, F(D), P_C, P_D, P_W, P_AkD, and P_AkW.
output: A notation interface for the physical and Bayesian models.
handoff: The collision model first uses N0, N, V, alpha, beta, v, theta, and I.

moves: input: Aircraft volume, total mass, impact velocity and angle, disintegration regime, and unobserved calibration constants.
rhetorical job: Separate maximum searchable material from the fraction released by a particular collision.
analytical job: Set N0=alpha V; use N=beta N0; derive I=mv sin(theta); map impulse through a zero-linear-saturation beta function with I0 and gamma.
output: An actual drifter-count N for later surface-target reasoning.
handoff: The simulation module places those targets at the impact point and evolves synthetic trajectories.

moves: input: An impact location, generated drifters, current data, and an unspecified computer-random motion process.
rhetorical job: Introduce a synthetic environment for comparing search outputs with hidden target trajectories.
analytical job: Initialize targets together, apply current-based motion plus random motion, and generate debris distributions and trajectories.
output: A simulated target-location history intended for model measurement and correction.
handoff: The Bayesian overview defines how actual search reports, rather than hidden simulator state, update location beliefs.

moves: input: Unknown target cell S_i,j, accessible information, binary search reports B, and separate surface/underwater phases.
rhetorical job: Give the reader a prediction-update contract and phase flow before any incident-specific prior is mixed.
analytical job: Define a location prior, observation likelihood, posterior, recursive update, and the surface-to-underwater handoff shown in Figure 2.
output: A two-phase Bayesian state-estimation and control loop.
handoff: Section 6.4 constructs the surface prior from flight dynamics and reverse drift.

moves: input: Last-known-position reachability, a nine-accident distance curve, reverse-drift evidence from spotted targets, OSCAR currents, search cells, and binary reports.
rhetorical job: Keep each evidence source and weight visible while converting them into an updateable surface-search distribution.

analytical job: Mix equal-probability LKP reachability with F(D)=1-22/(D^2+22) at 50/50; reverse-interpolate currents with a 0.25 speed factor; mix flight and drift priors at 70/30; apply normalized Bayes updating over the current search area.
output: A surface-search prior and posterior PDF over cells.
handoff: The underwater model reuses the surface posterior with the flight-dynamics prior.

moves: input: The surface posterior, flight-dynamics prior, underwater platform likelihood, and phase-specific detection reports.
rhetorical job: Turn the surface result into a recursive underwater plan without treating one failed phase as elimination.

analytical job: Mix 30% surface posterior with 70% flight prior; suspend surface search; replace drifter states and likelihoods with wreckage states and likelihoods in Bayes' rule; recurse after misses.
output: Phase-indexed underwater priors and posteriors until detection or intentional suspension.
handoff: The allocation model assigns available aircraft to high-probability cells in either phase.

moves: input: An updated cell PDF and search aircraft with heterogeneous area limits and detection rates.
rhetorical job: Connect spatial priority to resource selection through a named, inspectable optimization objective.

analytical job: Sort cells and aircraft in descending order, match stronger aircraft to larger cell probabilities, and state cumulative detection probability as the branch-and-bound maximization objective.
output: A ranked aircraft-to-cell allocation plan.
handoff: The application section uses the probability pipeline on AF447 and MH370, though it does not expose a complete allocation trace.

moves: input: AF447 recovery data and initial-search drifter distribution; MH370 satellite/radar path analyses, accessible probability regions, and assumed nondetections.
rhetorical job: Demonstrate two distinct uses: retrospective region comparison and conditional prospective search distribution.

analytical job: For AF447, mix flight prior and initial surface evidence and compare the highest-probability region with the known wreckage point; for MH370, adopt an external path distribution and propagate no-detection updates through the search phases.
output: An AF447 underwater-prior map and four MH370 phase PDFs.
handoff: Sensitivity analysis varies selected target, resource, and mixture inputs around the paper's unspecified baseline case.

moves: input: A cumulative wreckage-detection metric, selected drifter counts, fleet sizes, nine platform profiles, and three pairs of mixture weights.
rhetorical job: Show local output response to named physical, resource, platform, and weight choices.
analytical job: Evaluate N in {50,100,200}; fleet count in {2,3,4}; selected two-plane combinations; and 30/70, 50/50, 70/30 weight pairs for three prior mixtures.
output: Six small deterministic sensitivity tables and directional interpretations.
handoff: Strengths and weaknesses convert these local responses and applications into broader claims and admitted limits.

main_argument_chains.claim: Aircraft properties, impact severity, and current-driven motion define what may be detectable and where evidence may originate.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: represent what may be detectable and where it may move before search reports arrive

main_argument_chains.claim: LKP reachability, accident distance, reverse drift, and a search report move the surface stage from prior mixture to normalized posterior.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: prioritize the next surface-search cells under explicit evidence and weight assumptions

main_argument_chains.claim: Surface evidence and flight dynamics form an underwater prior that becomes recursively updated after each unsuccessful phase.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: continue underwater localization without treating a missed phase as proof of absence

main_argument_chains.claim: Ranked cell and platform capability interfaces carry the probability state into allocation, AF447 comparison, and conditional MH370 fields.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: assign stronger resources to higher-priority regions and retain each case's evidence boundary

main_argument_chains.claim: Local target, fleet, and weight sweeps delimit what can be communicated through limitations, press chronology, and reference provenance.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: communicate only the local stability, application trace, and operational sequence supported by the declared artifacts

warnings.warning: N0=alpha V is structurally clear, but alpha is neither identified from aircraft/debris data nor given a unit-consistent value; it must remain an uncalibrated parameter.
The printed velocity components are v_x=cos(theta) and v_y=sin(theta), omitting multiplication by v and conflicting dimensionally with the later I=mv sin(theta) expression.
The prose calls m total weight while the impulse equation treats m as mass; units must be reconciled before numerical use.
The piecewise beta rule is explicit, but I0 and gamma have no data source, fitted values, units audit, or uncertainty, so it cannot yield a reproduced drifter count.
Equation (6) is retained as F(D)=1-2^2/(D^2+2^2) with medium transcription confidence, but the nine-accident sample, distance units, fitting criterion, residuals, and uncertainty are absent.
Equation (7) is a normalized Bayes form, but P(B|S_i,j), report semantics, detection rates, cell evidence, and numerical arrays are not parameterized, preventing posterior reproduction.

visualization_dispositions.analytical_purpose: Establish speed, voyage, and sensor heterogeneity before the allocation model.
Expose the symbols connecting drifter count, collision, cell probabilities, and surface/underwater detection.
Connect the contact angle and velocity decomposition to the impulse-based disintegration rule.
Make the 50/50 flight prior, 70/30 surface prior, recursive Bayes updates, underwater transition, and allocation handoffs inspectable.
Supply the accident-distance component of the flight-dynamics prior.
Combine the LKP reachability field and accident-distance distribution into one search prior.
Illustrate divergence under the paper's system module and motivate down-weighting reverse drift.
Show the 70-percent flight and 30-percent reverse-drift mixture before search reports arrive.
Visualize the normalized Bayes update after a surface-search report.
Transfer the surface-stage result and flight prior into the first underwater search phase.
Show how an unsuccessful underwater phase changes the next-phase search distribution.
Make the ranked matching of stronger aircraft to higher-probability cells concrete.
Compare the source pipeline's suggested AF447 region with the reported wreckage location.
Show how successive MH370 search proposals shifted across large arc-shaped regions.
Provide the constrained-autopilot and data-error distribution used as the conditional MH370 flight prior.
Carry the conditional MH370 distribution through surface prior, surface posterior, underwater prior, and underwater posterior stages.
Expose how the stated cumulative localization probability changes with N.
Expose the local resource response when nominal aircraft capability is fixed.
Define area limits and surface/underwater detection inputs for allocation sensitivity.
Compare cumulative localization values for selected two-aircraft type combinations.
Check the output response to LKP-versus-distance mixture weights.
Check the output response to flight-versus-reverse-drift surface-prior weights.
Check the output response to surface-posterior-versus-flight underwater-prior weights.
